name: time_weighted_inventory_turnover_midyear_acquisition
question_template: A retailer time-weights average inventory: each balance is weighted by the whole months it is held in the 12-month year, and the weighted sum is divided by 12. Standalone inventory is {OPEN_INV} USD in months 1-6; a seasonal adjustment of {H2_CHANGE} USD (added algebraically; negative means a reduction) applies in months 7-12. Standalone cost of goods sold for the year is {COGS_SA} USD. On the first day of month {ACQ_MONTH} the retailer acquires a business holding {ACQ_INV} USD of inventory, held at that level for the rest of the year and incurring cost of goods sold of {ACQ_COGS_MONTH} USD per month after closing. Policy: if closing is in month 6 or earlier, the acquired inventory enters the time-weighted average for the months held and its post-closing cost of goods sold is added to consolidated cost of goods sold; if closing is in month 7 or later, both are excluded entirely as non-comparable. Inventory turnover is cost of goods sold used divided by average inventory; days inventory on hand is {DAYS} days divided by turnover. Compute days inventory on hand.

slots.description: Time-weighted average inventory under the applicable policy branch
Consolidated cost of goods sold used in the turnover ratio
Inventory turnover on the time-weighted average

program:
def solve():
    open_inv = Fraction(P["OPEN_INV"])
    h2_change = Fraction(P["H2_CHANGE"])
    cogs_sa = Fraction(P["COGS_SA"])
    m = int(P["ACQ_MONTH"])
    acq_inv = Fraction(P["ACQ_INV"])
    acq_cogs_month = Fraction(P["ACQ_COGS_MONTH"])
    days = Fraction(P["DAYS"])
    if m < 2 or m > 12:
        raise ValueError("acquisition month must be between 2 and 12")
    sa_h2 = open_inv + h2_change
    if sa_h2 <= 0:
        raise ValueError("second-half standalone inventory must be positive")
    weighted = 6 * open_inv + 6 * sa_h2
    months_held = 13 - m
    if m <= 6:
        weighted += acq_inv * months_held
        cogs_used = cogs_sa + acq_cogs_month * months_held
    else:
        cogs_used = cogs_sa
    avg_inventory = weighted / 12
    turnover = cogs_used / avg_inventory
    dio = days / turnover
    return {"final": dio, "avg_inventory": avg_inventory, "cogs_used": cogs_used, "turnover": turnover}
